metadata.price_name: Ontario market energy price: legacy HOEP to April 2025, then the Ontario Price (OEMP)
metadata.price_basis: Energy is the legacy Hourly Ontario Energy Price (HOEP) until it retired on April 30, 2025, and the Ontario Electricity Market Price (OEMP, the Ontario Price = Day-Ahead Ontario Zonal Price + Load Forecast Deviation Adjustment) from May 1, 2025, published by the IESO in $/MWh and shown here in $/kWh. Monthly values: legacy HOEP months use the arithmetic mean of every hourly HOEP value (checked against the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report) and that report's demand-weighted average; Ontario Price months use the IESO monthly Ontario Price table (arithmetic and weighted averages), checked against the project's hourly archive when the archive covers the whole month.
metadata.ga_basis: Global Adjustment Class B actual monthly rate: "Actual Rate ($/MWh)" in the IESO Data Directory Global Adjustment workbook (cross-checked against the IESO cents-per-kWh workbook) or, for months the workbook does not list yet, ActualRate in the IESO Global Adjustment monthly report; where both list a month they must agree within 0.005 $/MWh. The rate applies to every hour of its month, so energy + GA is what a market-billed Class B customer paid per kWh for energy. Class A customers pay Global Adjustment by their peak demand factor instead.

window.complete_rule: A month is complete when it has ended, its energy value is validated (legacy HOEP months: the hourly mean matches the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report within 0.01 $/MWh; Ontario Price months: listed in the IESO monthly table, and within 0.01 $/MWh of the hourly archive when the archive covers the whole month) and its Class B Global Adjustment actual rate is published. The window is the latest 60 consecutive complete months.

eras.name: Ontario Electricity Market Price (Ontario Price, OEMP)

gap.reason: The IESO keeps its daily Day-Ahead Ontario Zonal Price reports online for only about 90 days and the project's hourly Ontario Price archive starts on 2026-07-11, so the hourly Ontario Price before then cannot be recovered. Monthly values for those months come from the IESO monthly table; the heatmap uses only observed hours and is never filled with modelled hours.

metadata.heatmap_basis: Each bin averages the observed hourly energy prices that fall in it inside the window months: legacy HOEP hours (until the HOEP retired on April 30, 2025) and archived Ontario Price hours. Hours without an observed price are left out, never modelled: the Ontario Price from 2025-05-01 to 2026-07-10 and hours whose LFDA is not yet published or was published blank. The legacy HOEP hours of 2025-04 are left out too, because they could not be validated against the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report. Global Adjustment is each hour's monthly Class B actual rate, so a bin's Global Adjustment is hour-weighted. hours_hoep and hours_oemp count the hours of each era in a bin.

hoep_retirement.statement: The Hourly Ontario Energy Price (HOEP) retired on April 30, 2025, and was replaced with the Ontario Price.

unobserved_hoep_months.reason: No validated hourly legacy HOEP values: the IESO yearly hourly HOEP report for the final, partial year does not reproduce the HOEP Monthly Averages report for this month (or no hourly report exists), so the month's hours are left out of the heatmap and its monthly values come from the HOEP Monthly Averages report.

incomplete_months.reason: energy not validated (not in the IESO monthly table)

ga_adjustments.description: During 2021 the deferred 2020 amount was recovered from non-RPP Class B customers through separate monthly Class B recovery rates (actual 5.01-7.09 $/MWh). The IESO's published 2021 actual rates, used here, do not include them.

source_codes.hoep_hourly: Arithmetic: mean of every hourly legacy HOEP value (data/market/hoep_hourly.csv, imported from the IESO yearly hourly HOEP reports), checked against the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report; weighted: that report's demand-weighted average.
source_codes.hoep_monthly_report: Arithmetic and demand-weighted averages from the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report (legacy market; no hourly values archived for the month).
source_codes.oemp_monthly_table: IESO Ontario Market Prices monthly table: Ontario Price (OEMP) arithmetic (tab AA) and weighted (tab WA) averages.
source_codes.ga_workbook: IESO Data Directory Global Adjustment workbook, Class B 'Actual Rate ($/MWh)'.
source_codes.ga_monthly_report: IESO Global Adjustment monthly report (PUB_GlobalAdjustment_YYYYMM), Class B ActualRate ($/MWh).

sources.name: Project archive of the legacy hourly HOEP (data/market/hoep_hourly.csv), imported from the IESO Yearly Hourly HOEP OR Predispatch Reports
Project archive of the hourly Ontario Price (data/market/ontario_price_hourly.csv), from the IESO Day-Ahead Hourly Ontario Zonal Price and hourly LFDA reports
IESO Ontario Market Prices: monthly Ontario Price table (arithmetic and weighted averages)
IESO Global Adjustment rates in $/MWh, Class B actual (Data Directory workbook)

metadata.hour_convention: hour = IESO hour ending minus 1 (hour beginning). The legacy HOEP reports and the Ontario Price reports both use hours ending 1-24 in Eastern Standard Time all year (IESO market time, no daylight-saving shift; every day has 24 hours), so hour 0 covers 00:00-01:00 EST; while daylight time is in effect, hour 0 is 01:00-02:00 on local clocks.
metadata.day_type_rule: weekday = Monday-Friday, weekend = Saturday-Sunday, by IESO delivery date. Statutory holidays are not separated: a holiday counts as the day of the week it falls on.

hoep_monthly_arithmetic.basis: arithmetic mean of every hourly legacy HOEP value in the month vs the monthly history, which was checked against the IESO HOEP Monthly Averages report when the legacy hours were imported

oemp_archive_vs_table.basis: arithmetic mean of the archived hourly Ontario Price vs the IESO monthly table (tab AA), for months whose every hour has a published Ontario Price in the archive

ontario_price_table_sum.basis: DA-OZP + LFDA vs the Ontario Price (OEMP) in every row of both IESO monthly tables

ga_class_b_units.basis: Class B 'Actual Rate ($/MWh)' vs 10 x the 'Actual' rate in the IESO cents-per-kWh workbook

ga_workbook_vs_monthly_reports.basis: Class B actual rate in the IESO Data Directory workbook vs ActualRate in the IESO Global Adjustment monthly report, for months listed in both

metadata.notes: Observed market history for comparison only: not a tariff, a bill or a forecast. The Hourly Ontario Energy Price (HOEP) retired on April 30, 2025, and was replaced with the Ontario Price. Energy is the legacy HOEP to April 2025 and the Ontario Price (OEMP = DA-OZP + LFDA) from May 2025; Global Adjustment is the Class B actual monthly rate, so energy + GA is what a market-billed Class B customer paid per kWh for energy. Class A customers pay Global Adjustment by their peak demand factor, not the Class B rate shown here. Delivery, regulatory, loss and retail contract charges are not included. The hourly Ontario Price from 2025-05-01 to 2026-07-10 is not available (the IESO keeps its daily reports for about 90 days and the project's archive starts after that period), so those hours are left out of the heatmap and never modelled; monthly values for those months come from the IESO monthly table.
